requirements.text: The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is securely authenticated, encrypted, and energy-efficient.
The system shall implement a unified role-based access control that ensures privacy and compliance.
The system shall ensure students can dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
The system shall generate anonymized attendance reports resource-efficiently to protect student identities.
The system shall provide timely notifications of attendance status integrated with energy-efficient processes.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall implement energy-efficient methods for real-time data synchronization.
The system shall provide an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall enforce secure session timeouts to protect user data.
